description: KEYW, in coordination with the United States Special Operations Command (USSOCOM), has developed a Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 140-2 certified, standards-based Suite B Cryptographic Algorithms library that provides an advanced layer of encrypted data-in-transit communications and data-at-rest encryption for the BlackBerry ecosystem.
